three.js ESM build used by the 3D viewport. The file must be named three.module.js:

  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js

If the file is present it is loaded locally; otherwise the viewport falls back to the CDN
(offline, the viewport stays blank). Any version from 0.160 on works.

three.js is MIT-licensed; its license is in LICENSE-three.txt next to this file.
